headline: Approved the prior meeting minutes and scheduled meetings with Karen Bevins of Arts and Culture and the Mayor.
summary: The meeting covered textile collection, a food waste composting proposal, and recruiting new members. Members approved the previous minutes and voted to schedule meetings with Karen Bevins and the Mayor.
decisions: Approved the previous meeting minutes by unanimous vote.
Approved a motion to meet with Karen Bevins from the Arts and Culture, by unanimous vote.
Approved a motion to vote on scheduling a meeting with the Mayor after the NLR report is submitted, by unanimous vote.

decision_evidence.quote: Chairperson Kosowski introduced a motion to approve the minutes from the last meeting. Commissioner Allgood seconded the motion, and it was approved by unanimous vote.

A motion to vote on scheduling a meeting with the Mayor for after the submission of the report from NLR was introduced by the Chairperson, the motion was seconded by Commissioner Kevin, and approved unanimously.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Solid Waste & Recycling Commission 
Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
7:00 PM, October 14, 2026 
 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
  
 
• Chairperson Kosowsky called the meeting to order at 7:08 PM, and was seconded 
by Commissioner Theresa Allgood. 
 
2. ATTENDANCE 
  
 
• In attendance: Kosowsky, Commissioner and Chairperson, Theresa Allgood, 
Commissioner, Eben Pariser, Commissioner, and Joe DiRisi, the Recycling 
Coordinator for the town of Hamden. 
• Absent: Commissioners Shenira Billups, & Charity Ford. 
 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
  
 
• Chairperson Kosowski introduced a motion to approve the minutes from the last 
meeting. Commissioner Allgood seconded the motion, and it was approved by 
unanimous vote.  
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT 
  
 
• None. 
 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.
1. 
• As submitted. 
  
  
 
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 
• Not needed. 
 
7. REPORTS 
  
 
 
8. OLD BUSINESS 
  
 
 
  1. Going forward with the textile collection. Discussion regarding swaps, providing non-
profits with needed items; storing textiles; eliciting volunteers; meeting with the 
Mayor's Office.   
  
• Textile Collection: 
• Having four events a year, and involving houses of worship, chambers of 
commerce, non-profit groups and others. 
• Fixing the roof at the barn for use in textile swaps. 
• Swap and sorting day planned for November 7th, 2026 
 
  2. Proposal to be submitted to the Mayor’s Office: proof of concept for local food waste 
composting. National Laboratory of the Rockies. Scheduling meeting; notifying the 
public.  
  
• A proposal on local food waste to be submitted to the Mayor’s office. 
• The National Lab of the Rockies, giving 40 hours of technical assistance to 
study the viability of two approaches: one, a standalone in-vessel system 
designed to manage organic waste generated by the town of Hamden, and 
two, a regional system (SAP), large enough to accommodate organic waste 
collected through the 15 SCROG municipalities, using the Hamden transfer 
station.  
 
9. NEW BUSINESS 
  
 Recruitment of new Board/Commissioners:
• Gary Drucker has expressed interest in joining. 
• No need to change the Commission’s meeting schedule. 
 
  1. Tire EPR. 
   
  
 
  2. Mattress and their Management: collection and recycling under EPR.  
  
• Motion to meet with Karen Bevins from the Arts and Culture was introduced by 
the Chairperson, seconded by Commissioner Theresa Allgood, and approved 
unanimously.  
• A motion to vote on scheduling a meeting with the Mayor for after the 
submission of the report from NLR was introduced by the Chairperson, the 
motion was seconded by Commissioner Kevin, and approved unanimously. 
 
10. ADJOURNMENT 
  
 
• The motion to adjourn was introduced by the Chairperson at 8:03 PM and was 
approved by unanimous vote.
